item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🏗 Doing everything conscientiously: the Russian Defense Minister inspected new apartment buildings for military personnel in Vladivostok, and also assessed the progress of construction of facilities of the 55th Guards Marine Division named after twice Hero of Russia M.E. Gudkov. 🚩 Another one line has been reached: units of the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated the settlement of Gruzskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic. 💥 Cutting off the AFU's arteries: Russian troops hit the logistics centre in Kiev region, electric substations, and two ports in Odessa region, where were dry cargo ships with military cargo and Western-made weaponry. 🤝 Working together as one: the surgeon with the call sign 'Scalpel' shared how the system of saving wounded soldiers is built. ▫️ Diligence is mother of success: combat training took place at training grounds of Moscow Military District. #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against logistics centres, port infrastructure facilities of Ukraine, and maritime vessels operating
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch group strikes against logistics centres, port infrastructure facilities of Ukraine, and maritime vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 During the day, long-range attack drones hit: 📍 a logistics centre where dual-purpose goods and military equipment were stored and distributed in the settlement of Brovary of Kiev region; 📍 a logistics centre involved in providing the Armed Forces of Ukraine with military equipment in the city of Nikolayev; 📍 in Odessa region: ▪️ a concentration area of heavy trucks, used to provide the AFU's units with ammunition and materiel in the settlement of Dachnoye; ▪️ a dry cargo ship with military hardware supplied to the AFU by Western countries in the port of Chernomorsk. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship and a tanker with UAV production components, ammunition, and fuel for the Armed Forces of Ukraine was hit in the Black Sea waters east of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 Neutralising mock enemy: Northern Fleet confirms readiness to any scenario Severomorsk, Murmansk region

item.title: ❗️ From 29 August to 4 September, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out one massive and 17 group strikes with high-precision weapons and long-range drones,
item.description: ❗️ From 29 August to 4 September, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out one massive and 17 group strikes with high-precision weapons and long-range drones, which hit enterprises of defence industry of Ukraine, logistics centres, fuel-power and transport infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, drone manufacturing workshops and warehouses, ammunition, fuel and materiel depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries. 🔥 In addition, a number of the Ukrainian ports infrastructure facilities, which provided reception and storage of military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, have been disabled . 🔥 During the week, eight dry cargo ships and one container ship operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, were neutralised. 🚩 Last week, as a result of decisive actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces established control over the settlements of Khrapovshchina, Sadki and Velikiy Prikol (Sumy region), Kazachya Lopan, Vasilevka, Dolzhanka, and Blagodatnoye (Kharkov region). 💥 They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, three territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade. ▪️ In total, the enemy lost more than 1,660 troops, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, 63 motor vehicle
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29213

❗️
From 29 August to 4 September, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out one massive and 17 group strikes with high-precision weapons and long-range drones,
which hit enterprises of defence industry of Ukraine, logistics centres, fuel-power and transport infrastructure facilities used by the Armed Forces of Ukraine, drone manufacturing workshops and warehouses, ammunition, fuel and materiel depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries.
🔥
In addition, a number of the Ukrainian ports infrastructure facilities,
which provided reception and storage of military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants used in the interests of the Ukrainian Armed Forces,
have been disabled
.
🔥
During the week, eight dry cargo ships and one container ship operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, were neutralised.
🚩
Last week, as a result of decisive actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces
established control over the settlements of Khrapovshchina, Sadki and Velikiy Prikol (Sumy region), Kazachya Lopan, Vasilevka, Dolzhanka, and Blagodatnoye (Kharkov region).
💥
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware
of five mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, three territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 1,660 troops, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, 63 motor vehicles, 10 field artillery guns, and nine electronic and counter-fire stations in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
🚩
During the week, as a result of active actions, units of the Zapad Group of Forces
liberated Svyatogorsk (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
Strikes were delivered at
formations of four mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades.
▪️
The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,415 troops, 15 armoured fighting vehicles, 112 motor vehicles, and 10 field artillery guns.
🚩
Last week, units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and
liberated Izhevka and, on 3 September, they liberated Nikanorovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of
three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one mountain assault brigade, one airmobile brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade.
▪️
Over the past week, in the area of responsibility of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces, has lost more than 1,365 troops, 20 armoured fighting vehicles, 181 motor vehicles, and 17 field artillery guns.
🚩
During the week, as a result of active offensive actions of the Tsentr Group of Forces,
the settlements of Rubezhnoye, Novoandreyevka, and, today, Gruzskoye (Donetsk People's Republic) have been liberated.
💥
Strikes were delivered at
formations of four mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one airborne brigade, one assault brigade, one jaeger brigade, three assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, two marine brigades, and three national guard brigades.
▪️
The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 2,685 troops, 18 armoured fighting vehicles, 80 motor vehicles, eight field artillery guns, and six electronic warfare stations.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
